items.content_html: On 5 November, 10 teams descended upon a 52-acre mock town in College Station, Texas called Disaster City. They were there for a nine-day competition to see how well teams of robots and humans could navigate simulated catastrophes, like a market ravaged by a tornado and a nighttime strike on a military base. At stake? US $2.5 million in prize money.The scenarios were the final of the DARPA Triage Challenge, which the U.S. agency has been running for three years with the goal of saving more lives
